## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and why it matters. The initial repository has no working simulator.

## Reproduction

Include minimal inputs, exact steps/commands, project revision, OS, and relevant backend/toolchain versions.

## Expected and actual results

Include units, virtual timestamps, logs, or screenshots when relevant. Remove personal paths, credentials, and private firmware.

## Related requirement or task

Reference an RF/RNF requirement or SN task if known. Follow SECURITY.md for sensitive reports.
